description: Five single-variable 3-seed formal feature-fusion structure refinements.

variants.title: FF-STRUCT-01-GLU-HIDDEN384-3SEED-FORMAL
variants.rationale: Increase only the GLU fusion-head hidden width from 256 to 384 while keeping ResNeXt 256x8 geometry, mean pooling, recalibration, xview mixer, and scalars fixed.
variants.expected: A wider gated fused-token head may model higher-order cross-view feature interactions that the existing 256 bottleneck compresses, improving val_acc if current head capacity is the limiting feature-fusion path.

variants.title: FF-STRUCT-02-GLU-HIDDEN128-3SEED-FORMAL
variants.rationale: Reduce only the GLU fusion-head hidden width from 256 to 128 while keeping all feature-fusion modules and training scalars fixed.
variants.expected: A narrower gated head may regularize fused-token gating and reduce seed-level variance, especially the weaker seed456 anchor, while preserving the GLU mechanism that beat the plain MLP ablation.

variants.title: FF-STRUCT-03-XVIEW-RESIDUAL00625-3SEED-FORMAL
variants.rationale: Change only the CrossViewAttention residual scale from 0.125 to 0.0625 while keeping the mixer architecture, GLU head, and scalars fixed.
variants.expected: A weaker cross-view residual may retain the positive interaction signal while reducing noisy view-token overwrite, improving stability when a view-specific feature is already discriminative.

variants.title: FF-STRUCT-04-XVIEW-RESIDUAL025-3SEED-FORMAL
variants.rationale: Change only the CrossViewAttention residual scale from 0.125 to 0.25 while keeping the mixer architecture, GLU head, and scalars fixed.
variants.expected: A stronger cross-view residual may help the fused representation use non-dominant view context before concatenation, improving val_acc if the current mixer under-shares complementary evidence.

variants.title: FF-STRUCT-05-XVIEW-DIM512-3SEED-FORMAL
variants.rationale: Change only the CrossViewAttention internal attention dimension from 256 to 512 while keeping one layer, four heads, residual scale 0.125, and all training scalars fixed.
variants.expected: Full-dimensional cross-view attention may preserve channel detail that the 256-dim mixer compresses, improving feature-level multi-view interaction without changing input geometry or the final GLU head.
